text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"དེ་དག་ཀྱང་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་དུ་སྣང་བས་སྐྱེ་བ་ཉིད་མེད་དོ།","english":"those too appear in reality, so there is no birth itself.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says they appear as 'thatness' (reality), but the English implies they appear as real things, contradicting the context of falsity.","certainty":"medium"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: those too appear in reality, so there is no birth itself.
contradictions.why: The source says they appear as 'thatness' (reality), but the English implies they appear as real things, contradicting the context of falsity.
